structured_facts.statement: CATL published the page on 27 October 2026; its title describes sodium-ion storage scaling internationally.
CATL attributes a memorandum with INTILION covering 3 GWh of TENER storage systems over five years in Germany, Switzerland and Austria for grid-scale and commercial and industrial uses.
CATL says the parties have deployed more than 30 storage projects in Germany since 2022.
CATL says the parties expect to advance sodium-ion and lithium-ion routes in parallel.
The body does not identify the chemistry of the 3 GWh tranche, a commissioned sodium-ion site, delivery or acceptance records, or independently measured field performance.
INTILION's 8 May 2025 release describes an earlier up-to-10-GWh TENER partnership and serves only as context; no same-date INTILION counterpart was established in this bounded review.

limitations: The CATL page is a supplier-authored announcement and is not independent performance evidence.
The page does not establish that the 3 GWh tranche uses sodium-ion chemistry.
No named commissioned sodium-ion site, acceptance record or operating dataset is supplied.
No full article text or image is reproduced.
